description: Upsert an evidence item's tracking fields (write — editor+ role). Creates the tracking row if missing. All body fields are optional; only provided fields are applied.

collecting_system.description: Name of the tool or system that collects the evidence

evidence_id.description: Catalog evidence ID (e.g., 'E-IAM-01') — obtain from scf_list_evidence or scf_list_evidence_catalog

is_tracked.description: Toggle active tracking for this item

maturity_level.description: Evidence maturity level L0–L5 (e.g., 'L3'); omitting never clears the stored value

owner.description: Person accountable for this evidence item

system_id.description: System UUID to link this evidence to — obtain from scf_list_systems

name: scf_update_evidence
